	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-api-client-go/v2/api/datadog"
	"github.com/DataDog/datadog-api-client-go/v2/api/datadogV2"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/datasource"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/provider"
	providerschema "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/provider/schema"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/providerserver"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/resource"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/resource/schema"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/resource/schema/planmodifier"
	"github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/schema/validator"

)

// API-contract regression: create requires a caller-selected data.id.
func TestTFGenCallerAssignedIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, responseID := range []string{"assessment.metric", "ASSESSMENT.METRIC"} {
		t.Run(responseID, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Run("crud", func(t *testing.T) { testDerivedMetricIdentity(t, responseID) })
			t.Run("terraform_import", func(t *testing.T) { testDerivedMetricImportAdoption(t, responseID) })
		})
	}
}

func testDerivedMetricIdentity(t *testing.T, responseID string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	var mu sync.Mutex
	calls := map[string]int{}
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		mu.Lock()
		calls[req.Method]++
		mu.Unlock()
		wantPath := "/api/v2/metrics/derived-metrics"
		if req.Method != "POST" {
			wantPath += "/" + responseID
		}
		if req.URL.Path != wantPath {
			t.Errorf("unexpected path: %s", req.URL.Path)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if req.Method == "DELETE" {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		}
		if req.Method == "POST" || req.Method == "PUT" {
			var body struct {
				Data struct {
					ID string `json:"id"`
				} `json:"data"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			wantID := responseID
			if req.Method == "POST" {
				wantID = "assessment.metric"
			}
			if body.Data.ID != wantID {
				t.Errorf("%s data.id = %q", req.Method, body.Data.ID)
			}
		}

		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"data":{"id":%q,"type":"derived_metrics","attributes":{"definition":{"formula":"a","queries":[{"data_source":"metrics","name":"a","query":"avg:system.cpu.user{*}"}]}}}}`, responseID)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	cfg := datadog.NewConfiguration()
	cfg.Servers = datadog.ServerConfigurations{{URL: server.URL}}
	cfg.OperationServers = nil
	cfg.HTTPClient = server.Client()
	r := &datadogTfgenIdentityFixtureResource{Api: datadogV2.NewMetricsApi(datadog.NewAPIClient(cfg)), Auth: ctx}
	var schemaResponse resource.SchemaResponse
	r.Schema(ctx, resource.SchemaRequest{}, &schemaResponse)
	if id := schemaResponse.Schema.Attributes["id"]; id.IsRequired() || !id.IsComputed() {
		t.Error("API contract violated: API identity must be computed")
	}
	model := resourceDatadogTfgenIdentityFixture_Model{ID: types.StringUnknown(), Name: types.StringValue("assessment.metric"), Definition: &resourceDatadogTfgenIdentityFixture_DerivedMetricDefinitionModel{Formula: types.StringValue("a"), Queries: []*resourceDatadogTfgenIdentityFixture_DerivedMetricQueryModel{{DataSource: types.StringValue("metrics"), Name: types.StringValue("a"), Query: types.StringValue("avg:system.cpu.user{*}")}}}}
	plan := tfsdk.Plan{Schema: schemaResponse.Schema}
	if diags := plan.Set(ctx, &model); diags.HasError() {
		t.Fatalf("plan setup: %v", diags)
	}
	response := resource.CreateResponse{State: tfsdk.State{Schema: schemaResponse.Schema}}
	r.Create(ctx, resource.CreateRequest{Plan: plan}, &response)
	if response.Diagnostics.HasError() {
		t.Fatalf("create: %v", response.Diagnostics)
	}
	var state resourceDatadogTfgenIdentityFixture_Model
	if diags := response.State.Get(ctx, &state); diags.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(diags)
	}
	if state.ID.ValueString() != responseID {
		t.Fatalf("state ID: %v", state.ID)
	}
	idSchema := schemaResponse.Schema.Attributes["name"].(schema.StringAttribute)
	if !idSchema.IsRequired() || idSchema.IsComputed() {
		t.Fatal("name must be a required input")
	}
	for _, value := range []string{"", "assessment.metric"} {
		hasError := false
		for _, check := range idSchema.Validators {
			result := validator.StringResponse{}
			check.ValidateString(ctx, validator.StringRequest{ConfigValue: types.StringValue(value)}, &result)
			hasError = hasError || result.Diagnostics.HasError()
		}
		if hasError != (value == "") {
			t.Fatalf("id %q: validation error = %v", value, hasError)
		}
	}
	for _, changed := range []bool{false, true} {
		value := types.StringValue("assessment.metric")
		if changed {
			value = types.StringValue("renamed.metric")
		}
		requiresReplace := false
		for _, modifier := range idSchema.PlanModifiers {
			result := planmodifier.StringResponse{}
			modifier.PlanModifyString(ctx, planmodifier.StringRequest{
				Plan: plan, State: response.State,
				PlanValue: value, StateValue: types.StringValue("assessment.metric"), ConfigValue: value,
			}, &result)
			if result.Diagnostics.HasError() {
				t.Fatal(result.Diagnostics)
			}
			requiresReplace = requiresReplace || result.RequiresReplace
		}
		if requiresReplace != changed {
			t.Fatalf("identity changed=%v, requires replacement=%v", changed, requiresReplace)
		}
	}
	read := resource.ReadResponse{State: response.State}
	r.Read(ctx, resource.ReadRequest{State: response.State}, &read)
	if read.Diagnostics.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(read.Diagnostics)
	}
	if diags := read.State.Get(ctx, &state); diags.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(diags)
	}
	if state.ID.ValueString() != responseID || state.Name.ValueString() != "assessment.metric" {
		t.Fatalf("read identity: id=%v name=%v", state.ID, state.Name)
	}
	update := resource.UpdateResponse{State: read.State}
	r.Update(ctx, resource.UpdateRequest{Plan: plan, State: read.State}, &update)
	if update.Diagnostics.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(update.Diagnostics)
	}
	if diags := update.State.Get(ctx, &state); diags.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(diags)
	}
	if state.ID.ValueString() != responseID || state.Name.ValueString() != "assessment.metric" {
		t.Fatalf("updated identity: id=%v name=%v", state.ID, state.Name)
	}
	imported := resource.ImportStateResponse{State: tfsdk.State{Schema: schemaResponse.Schema}}
	if diags := imported.State.Set(ctx, &resourceDatadogTfgenIdentityFixture_Model{}); diags.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(diags)
	}
	r.ImportState(ctx, resource.ImportStateRequest{ID: responseID}, &imported)
	if imported.Diagnostics.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(imported.Diagnostics)
	}
	refresh := resource.ReadResponse{State: imported.State}
	r.Read(ctx, resource.ReadRequest{State: imported.State}, &refresh)
	if refresh.Diagnostics.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(refresh.Diagnostics)
	}
	if diags := refresh.State.Get(ctx, &state); diags.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(diags)
	}
	if state.ID.ValueString() != responseID {
		t.Fatalf("imported ID: %v", state.ID)
	}
	if !state.Name.IsNull() {
		t.Fatalf("imported name: %v", state.Name)
	}
	deleted := resource.DeleteResponse{State: refresh.State}
	r.Delete(ctx, resource.DeleteRequest{State: refresh.State}, &deleted)
	if deleted.Diagnostics.HasError() {
		t.Fatal(deleted.Diagnostics)
	}

	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	for method, want := range map[string]int{"POST": 1, "GET": 2, "PUT": 1, "DELETE": 1} {
		if calls[method] != want {
			t.Errorf("%s calls = %d, want %d", method, calls[method], want)
		}
	}
}

// Use the generated resource with a private local API, without provider credentials.
type identityTestProvider struct {
	FrameworkProvider
	api *datadogV2.MetricsApi
}

func (p *identityTestProvider) Metadata(_ context.Context, _ provider.MetadataRequest, resp *provider.MetadataResponse) {
	resp.TypeName = "datadog"
}

func (p *identityTestProvider) Schema(_ context.Context, _ provider.SchemaRequest, resp *provider.SchemaResponse) {
	resp.Schema = providerschema.Schema{}
}
func (p *identityTestProvider) Configure(context.Context, provider.ConfigureRequest, *provider.ConfigureResponse) {
}
func (p *identityTestProvider) Resources(context.Context) []func() resource.Resource {
	return []func() resource.Resource{func() resource.Resource {
		return &identityTestResource{datadogTfgenIdentityFixtureResource: &datadogTfgenIdentityFixtureResource{Api: p.api, Auth: context.Background()}}
	}}
}

func (p *identityTestProvider) DataSources(context.Context) []func() datasource.DataSource {
	return nil
}

type identityTestResource struct{ *datadogTfgenIdentityFixtureResource }

func (r *identityTestResource) Metadata(_ context.Context, req resource.MetadataRequest, resp *resource.MetadataResponse) {
	resp.TypeName = req.ProviderTypeName + "_tfgen_identity_fixture"
}

func (r *identityTestResource) Configure(context.Context, resource.ConfigureRequest, *resource.ConfigureResponse) {
}

func testDerivedMetricImportAdoption(t *testing.T, canonicalID string) {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	calls := map[string]int{}
	formula := "a"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		calls[req.Method]++
		if req.URL.Path != "/api/v2/metrics/derived-metrics/"+canonicalID {
			t.Errorf("unexpected canonical path: %s", req.URL.Path)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		switch req.Method {
		case "DELETE":
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		case "PUT":
			var body struct {
				Data struct {
					ID         string `json:"id"`
					Attributes struct {
						Definition struct {
							Formula string `json:"formula"`
						} `json:"definition"`
					} `json:"attributes"`
				} `json:"data"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			if body.Data.ID != canonicalID {
				t.Errorf("update id = %q", body.Data.ID)
			}
			formula = body.Data.Attributes.Definition.Formula
		case "GET":
		default:
			t.Errorf("unexpected method: %s", req.Method)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"data":{"id":%q,"type":"derived_metrics","attributes":{"definition":{"formula":%q,"queries":[{"data_source":"metrics","name":"a","query":"avg:system.cpu.user{*}"}]}}}}`, canonicalID, formula)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	cfg := datadog.NewConfiguration()
	cfg.Servers = datadog.ServerConfigurations{{URL: server.URL}}
	cfg.OperationServers = nil
	cfg.HTTPClient = server.Client()
	api := datadogV2.NewMetricsApi(datadog.NewAPIClient(cfg))
	config := func(name, formula string) string {
		return fmt.Sprintf(`
 provider "datadog" {}
 resource "datadog_tfgen_identity_fixture" "test" {
  name = %q
  definition = {
   formula = %q
   queries = [{ data_source = "metrics", name = "a", query = "avg:system.cpu.user{*}" }]
  }
 }
 `, name, formula)
	}
	address := "datadog_tfgen_identity_fixture.test"
	checkCalls := func(puts int) func() {
		return func() {
			mu.Lock()
			defer mu.Unlock()
			if calls["POST"] != 0 || calls["DELETE"] != 0 || calls["PUT"] != puts {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected API calls before cleanup: %v; want %d updates", calls, puts)
			}
		}
	}
	testingresource.UnitTest(t, testingresource.TestCase{
		ProtoV6ProviderFactories: map[string]func() (tfprotov6.ProviderServer, error){
			"datadog": providerserver.NewProtocol6WithError(&identityTestProvider{api: api}),
		},
		Steps: []testingresource.TestStep{
			{Config: config("assessment.metric", "a"), ResourceName: address, ImportState: true, ImportStateId: canonicalID, ImportStatePersist: true},
			{Config: config("assessment.metric", "a"), PreConfig: checkCalls(0),
				ConfigPlanChecks: testingresource.ConfigPlanChecks{PreApply: []plancheck.PlanCheck{plancheck.ExpectResourceAction(address, plancheck.ResourceActionUpdate)}},
				Check:            testingresource.ComposeTestCheckFunc(testingresource.TestCheckResourceAttr(address, "id", canonicalID), testingresource.TestCheckResourceAttr(address, "name", "assessment.metric")),
			},
			{Config: config("assessment.metric", "a"), PreConfig: checkCalls(1), PlanOnly: true},
			{Config: config("assessment.metric", "a * 2"),
				ConfigPlanChecks: testingresource.ConfigPlanChecks{PreApply: []plancheck.PlanCheck{plancheck.ExpectResourceAction(address, plancheck.ResourceActionUpdate)}},
				Check:            testingresource.TestCheckResourceAttr(address, "name", "assessment.metric"),
			},
			{Config: config("assessment.metric", "a * 2"), PreConfig: checkCalls(2), PlanOnly: true},
			{Config: config("renamed.metric", "a * 2"), PlanOnly: true, ExpectNonEmptyPlan: true,
				ConfigPlanChecks: testingresource.ConfigPlanChecks{PostApplyPreRefresh: []plancheck.PlanCheck{plancheck.ExpectResourceAction(address, plancheck.ResourceActionReplace)}},
			},
		},
	})
}
